text:
hana: Kickoff: small docs task Slice -> split the function/tool-calling page into three tiny anchorable snippets so SDK READMEs can link to exact examples. Keep snippets short and copyable.

eli: Agreed. Use stable kebab anchors: #snippet-invoke, #snippet-output-schema, #snippet-parse-fallback. No generated hashes.

hana: Checklist: 1) split into 3 anchored blocks, 2) wrap code with <Snippet lang="ts" copy /> or <Snippet lang="py" copy /> where appropriate, 3) add minimal JSON Schema + one valid example, 4) one-line parse-fallback note + tiny CLI demo, 5) run page link-checker.

prio-bot: deploy-preview: https://deploy-preview.redwood/docs/slice-4990 (CI: lint passed) :white_check_mark:

sameer: I'll author schemas. Keep them minimal: required props only, explicit types, set "nullable": false for required fields. Example tool output I'll show: `{"id":42,"result":"OK","meta":{"duration_ms":120}}` and then schema expecting only id (integer) and result (string). Also add one-line shim: `const { id, result } = response; // ignore meta`.

jo: I'll do the split/anchors PR. My changes will be just headings, code fences, and adding the snippet wrappers. Low-risk.

eli: Add a short migration note above snippets: "If upgrading SDK major versions, use the snippet labeled for your version." Show 3.x vs 4.x invocation forms.

hana: Parse fallback blurb under fallback snippet: "Fallback order: strict JSON -> tolerant JSON -> regex fallback." small CLI test showing strict fail then fallback success is enough.

jo: Timeline: open small PRs by Friday EOD. Prefix PR title with `docs: invoke micro-snippets`. Tag hana on PRs and add a one-line changelog entry.

sameer: Schema PR by Thursday EOD.

eli: Snippet UI PR later today.

hana: Thanks all, keep examples under ~20 lines. Ping me if you need scope cuts. :thumbsup:
